decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would result in the loss of an A1 retail unit in a secondary shopping parade, which would have an adverse effect on the vitality and viability of this shopping parade and Brentford District Centre, and would be contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1, S.1.3 and C.3.2 of the Council's Revised Deposit UDP (2001) and Policies ENV.1.1 and S.2.1A of the Council's Adopted UDP (1996).

Condition : 2 - The proposed shopfront would incorporate an oversized fascia that would be overdominant and unacceptable in design terms and out of keeping with the shop unit itself, the parade of shops and the Conservation Area. It would therefore be contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.2.2 of the Council's Revised Deposit UDP, Policies ENV.1.1, ENV.1.2 of the Council's Adopted UDP (1996) and the Council's Shopfront Design Guidelines (1992).
